title: Rule profile
description: A reusable description of the game rules in force during an era, mapped onto the ocgcore engine. Many formats share a profile; a profile never belongs to a single format. Where the engine cannot reproduce a historical rule, the gap is recorded rather than silently dropped.

official_ruleset_label.description: The official label players used at the time (e.g. 'pre-Master Rule expert rules', 'Master Rule (2008)'). Official labels do not always exactly reproduce historical TCG behaviour; the flags below are authoritative for what this profile actually configures.

preset.description: An ocgcore composite mode macro this profile corresponds to exactly, if one exists (e.g. DUEL_MODE_GOAT, DUEL_MODE_MR1). null when the profile is a custom flag combination.

flags.description: Individual ocgcore DUEL_* flags (not composite MODE macros) that make up this profile. The build verifies that, when preset is set, this list equals the preset's expansion for the pinned ocgcore revision.

ocgcore_reference.description: Commit or tag of edo9300/ygopro-core against which the flag names/values were verified.

client.description: Settings enforced by the EDOPro client/server rather than ocgcore: banned card types and deck size ranges (HostInfo.forbiddentypes and sizes; see docs/edopro-research.md). Hosts must set these manually — they cannot ship in a data repo.

engine_flag.description: The DUEL_* flag that reproduces this difference, or null if unrepresentable.

summary.description: A historical rule or ruling this profile cannot reproduce with current ocgcore flags.

tracking.description: Issue link or note about how/whether this could be fixed upstream.
